_comment: Agent name mappings (original → canonical for ManagedCatalog): fast-coder→coder | fast-manager→manager, deep-manager→manager | fast-coder→coder, deep-coder→coder | fast-inspector→inspector, deep-inspector→inspector | fast-devops→devops, deep-devops→devops | fast-browser→browser, deep-browser→browser | fast-inquiry→inquiry, deep-inquiry→inquiry | fast-reviewer→auditor, deep-reviewer→auditor | fast-orchestrator→orchestrator, deep-orchestrator→orchestrator | fast-distiller→distiller, deep-distiller→distiller | fast-blogger→blogger, deep-blogger→blogger. 原 20 名去前缀后含 legacy 名（coder/inspector/browser/inquiry/distiller）与未知名（auditor），已进一步收窄为插件配置校验接受的 7 个非 legacy 身份。
